description: This file defines the Controller component for the Claim module in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base module controller, uses a trait for user role management, and implements a handle method that redirects users to the default page for the 'claim' module.

classes.name: ClaimModuleController
classes.description: Controller class handling requests for the claim module, primarily responsible for redirecting to the module's default page.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming requests by redirecting the user to the default page of the claim module.
